data.content:
I submitted the dispute for DD-48230 for owner approval. It passed validation on the second try.

The first attempt failed for two reasons. The lint flagged "lied", which was a false match inside the word "applied", so I reworded it. The ticket evidence (`DD-48230:ticket_lists_item`) is neutral, not supportive, so it can't be cited as support.

The submitted dispute cites only `DD-48230:pickup_handoff`. That shows the order was ready at 13:24 and picked up at 13:29. The body still says the ticket lists the Green Smoothie but doesn't show how the order was packed. It doesn't cite the ticket as evidence.
